paragraphs.text: The prophet shows that if princes and judges do not do their duty, God whose authority is above them will take vengeance on them.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: For thieves and murderers find favour in judgment when the cause of the godly cannot be heard.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Not only when they cry for help, but when their cause requires aid and support.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: That is, all things are out of order either by their tyranny or careless negligence.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: foundations of the earth are out

paragraphs.text: No title of honour will excuse you, but you will be subject to God's judgments, and tender account as well as other men.
paragraphs.label: e
paragraphs.anchor: But ye shall die like men

paragraphs.text: Therefore no tyrant will pluck your right and authority from you.
paragraphs.label: f
